senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; cmp. לֶפֶס)a pot in which light is carried (v. Maim. to Kel. II, 8 a. Ar. s. v.); torch.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:8">Kel. II, 8</cite> <he>הל׳</he> (R. S. <cite ref="L00629"><he>לפוד</he></cite>) the light-pot.—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 52:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. LII</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 15:17">Gen. XV, 17</cite>) <he>ואין ל׳ אלא תורה וכ׳</he> torch means the Torah &c. (with ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 20:18">Ex. XX, 18</cite>); a. e.—Pl. <he>לַפִּידִים</he>.

Snh. 108ᵇ (ref. to לפיד, Job XII, 5) words שהם קשים כל׳ as hard as light-pots.—Trnsf. lightning, flash.—Pl. as ab. Mekh. Yithro s. 9 (ref. to Ex. l. c.) קולי קולות ולַפִּידֵי ל׳ various sounds and various flashes; וכמה … וכמה ל׳ היו were there various kinds of sounds? various kinds of flashes?; a. e.
